rules.rule: Amber (--amber, --amber-tint, --amber-text) only marks advancing places and winning results: advancing rows, the advance key, winning bracket scores, the champion label, the champion banner tint, the champion's placings row, the winning side of each finished series game, the winner's score in pool grid, schedule and bracket card chips, and the champion's name on the main page (--amber-text in dated rows, the --amber-tint champion line on Today). Never decoration, status or emphasis; the live scoreboard and running pool or bracket scores carry none.

The ember gradient fills only the one primary action per view (.btn-primary, submit); on the court view that is Finish match or Record game, ember only while enabled; on the main page New tournament, or Create while the create panel is open (New tournament hides). The brand tile is the product mark. Everything else is ghost; +1 is a surface fill.
--ember-glow appears only on the board-head band; the court strip is plain ink, including the main page band.
--ink fills the app bar, board head, court strip, flip cards, score chips, slot-grid score chips and court tags in both themes; text and accents on it use the --band-* tokens.
Organizer tools live in the Manage drawer, disclosures or the bracket match panel, never at equal weight with the board.

Interactive elements are at least 48px tall; the exception is the 40px standings refresh. On the court view +1 is 72px (88px on phones) and Finish match 56px. Slot-grid playing and ref cells are at least 56px. On the bracket page round tabs, Next and court links are at least 48px and the whole top of a match card is its button. On the main page the Courts link is at least 48px, dated rows 56px, and each whole Today panel and dated row is its link.
On a court the two columns and numerals own the first phone view; save status, Finish match and Up next follow in that order, with only the court strip above.

Scoring happens on the court scoreboard, not the pool or bracket page. They only link there (Score on Court N / Watch Court N); finished matches can be corrected in place (schedule row or match panel).
Amber on ink uses --amber; on light grounds (panels, tints, surfaces) it uses --amber-text.

In the slot grid a match with a score carries ink flip-card score chips; one still to come is only its court and opponent on the quiet --surface-2 cell, with no chips. A ref cell is an outline with no fill, and resting is a muted word. None borrows another's fill.

A bracket match on a court (both teams, not finished) is marked live: a 2px inset --accent-text ring and a court link. Nothing else on the bracket page wears that ring. The main page reuses the same ring for a tournament being played (the full-width Today row) and nothing else.
Tabs, pages, card-tree heads and Next links say rounds the same way (roundsOf); match names derive from them (Semis · match 2, or the round name alone); status reads in words (matchStatus).

The tournament page draws each bracket as the bracket page does (the card tree from 900px, round pages below), read-only and capped at 420px tall; a card leads to the bracket page, where matches open.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one ember action on a view (New tournament, Create, Finish match).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font: 700 16px/24px var(--emphasis); color: var(--on-ember); background: var(--ember); border: 0; border-radius: 12px; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 20px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--ember-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--ember-active); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: var(--focus); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: default; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Every other action: Cancel, Hold, Correct, Sign out.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { font: 500 16px/24px var(--nav); color: var(--text); background: var(--ghost); border: 0; border-radius: 12px; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 20px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms ease-in-out; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--ghost-hover); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { background: var(--ghost-active); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: var(--focus); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Square-cornered field with a label above; accent edge and ring on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-field span { font: 600 14.7px/21px var(--ui); color: var(--muted); } .ds-field input { font: 400 16px/24px var(--ui); color: var(--text); background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--field-border); border-radius: 0; min-height: 48px; padding: 11px 14px; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent-text); box-shadow: var(--focus); }

components.name: Stage Chip on a Panel
components.description: A tournament's stage; the dot is lit while it is being played, a hollow ring otherwise.
components.css: .ds-stage { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--ghost); color: var(--text); font: 600 14.7px/21px var(--ui); } .ds-stage::before { content: ""; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--muted); } .ds-stage-live::before { background: var(--accent-text); box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Score Chips
components.description: Small ink flip cards; the winner's score in amber on ink.
components.css: .ds-score { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-chip { position: relative; min-width: 44px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 8px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--band-ghost) 50%, transparent 50%), var(--ink); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--hairline); color: var(--band-text); font: 700 20px/34px var(--display); text-align: center; overflow: hidden; } .ds-chip::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 50% 0 auto; height: 1px; background: var(--flip-seam); opacity: .7; } .ds-won { color: var(--amber); } .ds-sep { color: var(--muted); font: 700 16px/1 var(--display); }

components.name: Court Tag
components.description: The court a schedule row is played on.
components.css: .ds-court-tag { font: 600 13px/18px var(--ui); color: var(--band-text); background: var(--ink); padding: 5px 9px; border-radius: 8px; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Live Panel Row
components.description: A tournament being played today: the whole panel is its link, marked with the live ring, Courts at its end.

narrative.overview:
Tournament Tracker runs a pool-and-bracket tournament at an outdoor venue, read on phones in daylight. Kiln gives it charcoal grounds, ink bands and boards, and a single ember accent, with Unbounded for names and headings and Inter for tables and rows.

The score and the standings lead every page. Organizer tools sit behind the Manage drawer, disclosures and the match panel. Amber is reserved for advancing and winning, the ember gradient for the one primary action on a view, and every target is at least 48px for use at arm's length.
keyCharacteristics: Ink bands and flip-card boards in both themes
One ember primary action per view
Amber only for advancing and winning
Unbounded display, Inter UI, tabular numerals
48px targets, larger on the court scoreboard

rules.body: Amber (--amber, --amber-tint, --amber-text) only marks advancing places and winning results: advancing rows, the advance key, winning bracket scores, the champion label, the champion banner tint, the champion's placings row, the winning side of each finished series game, the winner's score in pool grid, schedule and bracket card chips, and the champion's name on the main page (--amber-text in dated rows, the --amber-tint champion line on Today). Never decoration, status or emphasis; the live scoreboard and running pool or bracket scores carry none.

The brand tile is the product mark. Everything else is ghost; +1 is a surface fill.

rules.body: --ember-glow appears only on the board-head band; the court strip is plain ink, including the main page band.

rules.body: Organizer tools live in the Manage drawer, disclosures or the bracket match panel, never at equal weight with the board.

rules.body: Interactive elements are at least 48px tall; the exception is the 40px standings refresh. On the court view +1 is 72px (88px on phones) and Finish match 56px. Slot-grid playing and ref cells are at least 56px. On the bracket page round tabs, Next and court links are at least 48px and the whole top of a match card is its button. On the main page the Courts link is at least 48px, dated rows 56px, and each whole Today panel and dated row is its link.

rules.name: Score Comes First
rules.body: On a court the two columns and numerals own the first phone view; save status, Finish match and Up next follow in that order, with only the court strip above.

rules.name: Score On The Court
rules.body: Scoring happens on the court scoreboard, not the pool or bracket page. They only link there (Score on Court N / Watch Court N); finished matches can be corrected in place (schedule row or match panel).

rules.name: Amber By Ground
rules.body: Amber on ink uses --amber; on light grounds (panels, tints, surfaces) it uses --amber-text.

rules.name: Result Vs Match To Come
rules.body: In the slot grid a match with a score carries ink flip-card score chips; one still to come is only its court and opponent on the quiet --surface-2 cell, with no chips. A ref cell is an outline with no fill, and resting is a muted word. None borrows another's fill.

rules.body: Tabs, pages, card-tree heads and Next links say rounds the same way (roundsOf); match names derive from them (Semis · match 2, or the round name alone); status reads in words (matchStatus).

rules.name: Tournament Page Read Only Tree
rules.body: The tournament page keeps the read-only SVG tree and champion banner; matches open only on the bracket page.

dos: Do mark a match on a court, or a tournament being played, with the 2px --accent-text live ring.
Do use --band-* tokens for text and accents on ink.
Do keep every interactive element at least 48px tall.
donts: Don't use amber for decoration, status or emphasis.
Don't use the ember glow anywhere but the tournament board head.
Don't give a second action the ember gradient on the same view.
